description:
ERECTION OF A SINGLE STOREY DOUBLE GARAGE AND
USE OF REAR AREA AS TYRE FITTING GARAGE.
decision_conditions:
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:
AR-SA">Given the proximity of neighbouring and nearby residential properties, in
the absence of a noise impact assessment, or other information relating to
noise impacts, the applicant has failed to demonstrate that the proposed
development would not result in noise disturbance to neighbouring and nearby
residential properties at nos. 1-10 Upper Green East (inclusive) and nos.256, 258
and 260-262 London Road, contrary to London Plan Policy D3 and Policy D12.3 of
the Local Plan.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:
AR-SA">Whilst acknowledged that the proposed development is not subject to
statutory Biodiversity Net Gain, the application has failed to demonstrate any
biodiversity improvement by not incorporating ecologically friendly measures in
the construction process, which may include bird boxes, or bird bricks,
provision of suitable landscaping and if practicable green roofs and walls. In
the absence of this information, the applicant has failed to demonstrate that
the application complies with Policy G6 of the London Plan or Policy F15.9 of
the Local Plan in terms of biodiversity impact.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:
AR-SA">The application would involve additional car trips and is not accompanied
by an Air Quality Neutral statement to demonstrate compliance with London Plan
policy SI 1. Therefore, the submission has failed to demonstrate that it would
be air quality neutral.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:
AR-SA">The site is within an area at risk of groundwater flooding and the
applicant has submitted not provided any details of flood risk assessment including sustainable drainage; in
the absence of this information, the applicant has not demonstrated that the scheme would safeguard the risk of flooding in the locality nor address the issue of sustainable drainage.&nbsp; The development is in conflict with, in particular, London
Plan policies SI 12 and SI 13&nbsp; and Local Plan
Policy F15.9.</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:
AR-SA">In the absence of a Transport Statement or any other details regarding transport
impacts, &nbsp;the applicant has failed to
demonstrate that the transport impacts of the proposed development would be
acceptable and the application has failed to demonstrate that it would not have
an adverse impact on users of the adjacent public car park by way of congestion
and adverse impact to free flow of traffic in the locality to the detriment of highway safety for all road users, in conflict with, in particular policies T4 of the
London Plan and T16.2 of the Local Plan.</span></p>
